name: Waldorf Astoria Kuwait
positioning: Luxury hotel connected directly to The Avenues mall in Kuwait, with a spa built around hammams and vitality pools
best_for: Travelers who want shopping and dining at The Avenues on their doorstep
Families wanting a complimentary Kids Club and an outdoor pool
Guests who value a club lounge with private check-in and dining through the day

facts.text: Kuwait International Airport is within 12 kilometers of the hotel.
Rooms and suites have panoramic views of the city skyline.
All rooms have 65-inch HDTVs, espresso machines and 400-thread-count sheets.
The Ikaros Club serves breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, dinner and dessert, with complimentary beverages.
Ava serves fresh, light Mediterranean fare drawing on the flavors of the French Riviera, Southern Italy and the Greek islands.
Peacock Alley takes its inspiration from cafes in Paris and New York, serving salads, gourmet sandwiches, chocolates and macarons.
Outdoor cabanas are set up for family gatherings, romantic dinners or a cafe-style break.
The spa has separate areas for men and women, including private arrival and consultation lounges.
The family-friendly outdoor pool is surrounded by lush greenery, and private cabanas can be reserved.
The hotel has 13 flexible meeting rooms and a grand ballroom.

highlights.text: The hotel is connected directly to The Avenues, which the hotel describes as Kuwait's largest mall.
ROKA serves modern Japanese cuisine: sushi, sashimi and dishes cooked over hot coals on a traditional robata grill.
The Waldorf Astoria Spa has eight treatment rooms, three hammams and two vitality pools.
Ikaros Club guests get private check-in and check-out and a private meeting room.
The complimentary Kids Club is for children aged four to 12.

considerations.text: The hotel sits at The Avenues rather than downtown: the Grand Mosque of Kuwait and the city center are 14 kilometers away.
WhataHotel notes the property is alcohol-free, in keeping with local regulations.
